note: Sidecar path for App-open when dock strips instances/. Console Running cards still need Axle startInstances / Engine startInstance on docked tree. Proven 2026-10-01 on idea01+idea03 :18280 HTTP 302 + teacher/student* users.
passwordPolicyNote: password_policy disabled on sidecar; passwords >=10 chars
collabApplyNote: Prefer A collab (Nextcloud Text) needs one re-run on the pool when free: bash tests/duration-tests/scripts/post-dock-restore-running.sh --mode sidecar --apps nextcloud (creates the Drop Zone file request, chowns Collab + Drop Zone to www-data, enables Text, enable_sharing + Grade 5A on mounts, rescans; sets collabProvisioned=true). Until then Text opens the doc read-only (readonly-bar visible).

filesLayout.sidecar: Files root → 'Class Materials' | 'Drop Zone' | 'Collab' (one Local external storage per folder, created by 10-idea-files.sh; scoped to group Grade 5A after collab apply)
filesLayout.docked: Files root → 'Grade 5A Files' (FILES.yaml shareName) → 'Class Materials' | 'Drop Zone' | 'Collab'

collab.keepEditing: type a line into content (e.g. 'keep_editing <ISO time>'); Text autosaves via its sync session; peers on the same file see the edit and avatars (polling, no notify_push needed)
collab.closeDoc: close the Viewer modal → back to Files list (nc_browse)

shares.enableSharingOnMounts: true — fixture 10-idea-files.sh sets enable_sharing on every own mount at container start (+ provision_nextcloud_collab occ for already-running sidecars). Nextcloud default is false.
shares.note: Only the Drop Zone file request link is pre-created. Folders are visible to Grade 5A members as admin Local mounts; share_to_class creates the view-only group share on 'Class Materials' at walk time. FILES.yaml shareName 'Grade 5A Files' is the docked Files Disk mount name, not a Nextcloud share.

intentStatus.open_collab_doc: ready (opens in Text; read-only until collab apply)
intentStatus.keep_editing: ready_after_collab_apply (Nextcloud Text, Prefer A) — Collabora is Prefer B, not shipped

fileRequest.customToken: expected (core shareapi_allow_custom_tokens=yes); if NC refuses, the script records the random token here and in hosts.<host>.fileRequestUrl
